 Medium

 Print The latest Weekend Ka Vaar episode of Bigg Boss 20 saw Salman Khan question Love Gill over several incidents from the past week. The host discussed her behaviour inside the house, her equation with ScoutOP and her reaction to comedian Gaurav Gupta ’s roast during the Diwali special. Salman also brought up her heated argument with Arishfa Khan and questioned her intentions, saying, “Aapka bartav dekh kar aisa lag raha tha aap jaan bujh kar Arishfa ko uksaa rahi thi.” He suggested that Love was deliberately provoking the former captain and described her behaviour as “rage-baiting”.  During the conversation, Salman also asked Love about her response to Gaurav Gupta’s jokes. Love had earlier told the comedian that he needed therapy, a remark that became a talking point. Explaining why she reacted that way, she said, “Yeh kya tha ki aapko therapy ki zarurat hai? Sir, mujhe nahi achcha laga woh bol rahe the ki ‘aapko free ki woh cheez mil rahi hai.’ Kyunki woh situation alag thi jis cheez ke liye mujhe pichle hafte bhi toka gaya ki aapko bolna chahiye. Roast agar mere related hota toh mai usko leti par ek situation ko lekar usi ke baarein me karna mujhe nahi achcha laga.” Watch Salman Khan Makes First Airport Appearance Amid Tiger Shroff Firing Case; Investigation Intensifies Meanwhile, Bigg Boss 11 contestant Bandgee Kalra has come out in support of Love following the episode. Reacting to the Weekend Ka Vaar on X, she criticised the way the contestant was being treated and questioned the show’s approach towards her. Bandgee wrote, “What a disgusting WKV! Bhai, bina MG, bina big Pr and connection is show mein mat jana nai toh jo Love k sath hora hai vai hoga! Kisi ek koh bali banana hai and what is happening also shows the thought process and how much respect they have for women lol!” Bandgee’s post has added another dimension to the ongoing discussion around Love’s journey on the show. While some viewers have agreed with her and questioned Salman’s approach towards the contestant, others believe Love’s actions inside the house also deserved to be addressed. The episode has sparked mixed reactions among viewers, with social media users divided over whether Love was being unfairly singled out or was simply being held accountable for her behaviour.
